preconditions.description: The length of the palindrome is between 1 and 1000.
All characters in the palindrome are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The returned string is different from the original palindrome.

postconditions.expression: not (all(return_value[i] == return_value[-i-1] for i in range(len(return_value)//2)))
postconditions.description: The returned string is not a palindrome.
The returned string is lexicographically smaller than the original palindrome or is an empty string if no such replacement is possible.
